svg.text: POST create · GET my orders · GET /{orderNumber}
• validates event PUBLISHED + sales window; fraud gate
• builds PENDING order with line items (total + discount)
1. Purchase requires PUBLISHED event within sales window
3. Optional seat — one active reservation per seat + event
4. Lifecycle: PENDING → CONFIRMED → tickets issued → USED
5. Cancel / refund release inventory, only from eligible statuses
6. Payment handled by Payment Service; ticketing reacts via events
7. Validation flips ticket VALID → USED exactly once
seat snapshot stored on OrderItem / Ticket
